_doc: Frozen Gate-4 acceptance fixture (lead-authored 2026-10-16, spec §2.3 v3.2; reviewed by Fable). Quantities/strikes are hypothetical order shapes, not market data. v2 2026-10-16: netting flag, und_sec deliverable, sign validation (Fable PR-03a review).
holdings: confirmed positions of scope account U1 at as_of; qty signed; STK in shares; OPT in contracts.

orders: existing orders, any state. Candidate id is always 'cand' (distinct). envelope = order action; effective leg action = leg.action if envelope BUY else flipped; leg qty = ratio*qty. Non-BAG orders have one leg with action BUY and envelope = order action.

filled_after_snapshot = units filled after as_of (not in holdings). remaining = unfilled outstanding units (authoritative; do not derive from state or qty). qty - filled_after_snapshot - remaining = units filled before as_of (already in holdings; never counted again).

Order demand = filled_after_snapshot + remaining (per effective leg). Candidate demand = qty. {modify: id, new_qty}: new_qty is the new TOTAL qty; that order's outstanding becomes max(old_total,new_qty) - filled_total.

guaranteed: true = stored guarantee mode (explicit NonGuaranteed=0). Inside a guaranteed BAG, per ratio unit, leg deltas are summed per key and only the net short-call / short-stock delta is demand; a net long delta never supplies cover to other orders. Absent/false => every leg independent and BUY legs never offset.
Key = (sym, tc, exp, mult). Long call covers a short call of the same key. Shares cover only standard deliverable calls (mult 100, tc == sym). Unknown metadata => reject.
Assignment order: long calls first (they can only cover their own key), then shares (standard deliverables only). This order is optimal and deterministic.
view.complete defaults true; view.stale defaults false. Either false/true respectively => reject. Missing account on any order => reject. Candidate account must be U1.
expect: accept iff no short stock and uncovered short calls do not increase for any key; any fail-closed condition => reject.

netting_enabled (case-level, default false) is passed to evaluate(netting_enabled=...). Netting applies only when it is true AND the BAG is guaranteed AND every leg is OPT; otherwise legs are independent.
OPT legs carry und_sec (underlying secType). Shares cover a short call only when und_sec == 'STK', mult 100, tc == sym. und_sec missing or not 'STK' => shares never cover that call.
Integers must satisfy qty >= 1, remaining >= 0, filled_after_snapshot >= 0, new_qty >= 1; otherwise reject.

qty 2: 1 filled before as_of (already the held short), 1 remaining; demand 1 held + 1 remaining + 1 cand = 3 <= 3 -> accept (not 4)
